title: Tiffani Bova LinkedIn Live with Eric Ries — 'Why Good Companies Become Corrupt (Without Anyone Breaking the Rules)'
summary: Tiffani Bova is Chief Strategy & Research Officer at The Futurum Group, a two-time WSJ bestselling author and host of the What's Next! podcast. She hosted Eric for a LinkedIn Live on Incorruptible and posted the replay.
blockquote: In this conversation, we explored why organizations often drift from their original purpose, not because of bad people, but because of incentives, systems, and metrics that unintentionally reward the wrong behaviors. We also discuss how leaders can build organizations that remain innovative, customer-focused, and mission-driven as they grow.
